<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum lists ten carbon chemical shifts, but some shifts are repeated, indicating symmetry‑equivalent carbons. Distinct shift values are: 166.40, 131.87, 129.70, 129.01, 129.00, 52.24, 43.47, and 38.60 – a total of eight unique carbon environments.</thought>
